annotations.title: chainpeek: a transaction receipt on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Get a transaction receipt on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For value, nonce and confirmations too use get_transaction; for decoded events use decode_tx_logs. Returns the receipt of a mined transaction. An unknown or pending hash is a 200 with `status: not_found`. One RPC read. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only. Read-only. Reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad hash is a 422 before any payment (not charged). An unknown or pending hash is charged like any answer. Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html

chain.description: ethereum, base or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, chain id 4663).
